diagnostics.message: `module.runners:resource.aws_sqs_queue_policy.build_queue_dlq_policy` is the TLS-only policy intended for the dead-letter queue, but its `queue_url` points at `aws_sqs_queue.queued_builds` (the main build queue) instead of `aws_sqs_queue.queued_builds_dlq`. It therefore has no dependency on the DLQ at all: the DLQ is created with no queue policy (nothing in the config ever references it except the outputs), and this resource plus `aws_sqs_queue_policy.build_queue_policy` both manage the same queue's single policy, so they overwrite each other and drift on every apply. The resource should be ordered against (and wired to) the dead-letter queue.
